comment: Venues (ADR-024). Each scene is a 256x224 court scene made by tools/art/prep_court_scene.py; the first is the base. Tiles in BG1 palette 2 (the court, lines, net, sand, fence) must be the same in every scene and are shared; each venue has its own backdrop tiles and palettes 3-7. 'ground' names the court colour presets (court_colors.json) a DEFAULT choice means at this venue. Names fit the 8-cell COURT page. 'ambience' is the venue's background loop (ADR-031): birds, gulls, or crickets. 'watcher' is where the opponent's partner watches a singles match from (ADR-042): x and y of the feet (sitting: the seat), and sit or stand.
